Casa Curve Phuket

Townhouse in Phuket Town
HomeNew ProjectsCasa Curve Phuket

Official developer renders and plans from the Asset Pearl Casa Curve page. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Casa Curve Phuket is a project of 31 two-storey townhomes by Asset Pearl in the Wichit area of Mueang Phuket, marketed as an "affordable luxury townhome" close to local markets, schools, hospitals and the sea. The design concept, Casa Arco Contemporary, is built around curved lines.

The developer's site lists three 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom models with one parking space each: 116 sqm (13 units), 127.1 sqm (12 units) and 142.25 sqm (6 units). The project site is about 3,375 sqm (2 rai, 43.7 square wah), of which about 2,443 sqm is for sale.

No price list, completion date or ownership terms are published by the developer; portal asking prices of about THB 3.9-5.0 million could not be verified. Message us on WhatsApp for current prices and availability. Not to be confused with The Asset Curve Phuket in Si Sunthon.
